reviews.comment: Dr. Clifford is one of my favorite professors ever! He's extremely knowledgeable about every topic he teaches and makes complex concepts easier for us to understand. Discussion was encouraged and gave us fun brain-exercises that were applicable to the course. He loves his graphs, but him, the TA, the information, all made the class very enjoyable!

Professor Clifford was a great prof and you could truly tell he cares about his students. He mentioned this was his first large undergraduate class he has ever taught, and that was evident by how hard the first test was, but lots of points were given back and each test became easier. Gives extra credit as well!

I loved Dr. Clifford! He is one of the most caring professors I have had, and he wants to see all of his students succeed. He is very smart but does a great job communicating ideas and lessons for a 200-level course. I recommend you take him! Show up to class and do the work, and you should get an A

Prof. Clifford's knowledgeable on pols as a study & research methods w/n. Due to his expertise, his course material does feature lesser known terms & topics, but explains them thoroughly. POLS 233's a simple intro-level pols course. He does do random attendance grading, so be aware of that. Gracious & understanding w/ exam curves & extra credit!
